meta.title: PTC disk history
meta.description: Single-log PTC history: cold restore retains bounded display previews; GUI or explicit Agent tool reads requested pages from the original log. Normal model messages, tool outcomes and call identity stay unchanged; full display text enters context only when a page is explicitly requested. No maximum DSH package version is declared, but generate and test the matching native adapter snapshot for every installation. Requires a cold-start storage/AgentLoop/query replacement. New live PTC metadata remains resident.
